copy.sub: We spend them reading what already exists, comparing the field and building on the best of it. Our agency uses the tools we build.

copy.h: We read the field before we build.

copy.h: We aim to be the world’s leading open-source contributor.
copy.sub: So we read the field first: 1.3 million repos indexed, and every UI kit and agent base we can find, compared and credited. We build on the best of it, then open-source our whole agency stack. Here are the tools. Do it better than us. Bet you won’t.
